LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What do you remember most after reading a text? 2. How do we get information from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify mental images in a text correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use contextual clues to infer information and meanings of words correctly in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the role of comprehension in effective communication. • Read the passage on modern fashion and underline sentences that create mental images, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate adapted digital devices to underline the sentences. • Read the passage on modern fashion in turns as they answer direct and inferential questions, • Work with peers to infer the meaning of words and expressions using contextual clues, • Present mental pictures from the text on charts and display them. 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking as the learner identifies mental images and infers meanings of words.

• Collaboration as the learner contributes to group decision making while working with peers to infer the meaning of words

and expressions using contextual clues.

Values:
Responsibility as the learner accomplishes assigned tasks while presenting mental pictures from the text on charts and

displaying them.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Personal hygiene as the learner reads passages on fashion.

Link to other subjects:

The information acquired through reading texts on modern fashion is relevant in Social Studies.
